description: This Java class `CumulativeLoanSummaryDataProvider` is part of the Apache Fineract project. It provides computations related to cumulative loan summary data, including interest accrual calculations and transaction summaries for loan accounts. The class extends `CommonLoanSummaryDataProvider` and focuses on handling loan schedule periods, interest calculations, and associated data aggregation.

classes.name: CumulativeLoanSummaryDataProvider
classes.description: A Spring component class that provides specific loan summary calculations, especially related to interest accumulation and transaction summaries, for a loan management system.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if this data provider should be used based on the loan processing strategy code. Returns true unless the strategy code is 'advanced-payment-allocation-strategy'.

methods.name: computeTotalUnpaidPayableNotDueInterestAmountOnActualPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the total interest amount that is unpaid, payable, but not due, as of a given business date for a loan over a collection of schedule periods.

methods.name: withTransactionAmountsSummary
methods.description: Overrides a method to produce a loan summary data with transaction amounts, intended to be read-only, involving the loan object, default data, repayment schedule, and transaction balances.

methods.name: computeAccruedInterestTillDay
methods.description: A private helper method that computes the amount of interest accrued in a loan schedule period up until a given day, considering interest paid and waived, and returning it as a BigDecimal.
